subject: Fix VLA warning in linenoise and enable -Werror (#3439)
reason: The change is build-only with no behavior change: it replaces a const-int VLA dimension in deps/linenoise/linenoise.c with an equivalent #define of the same value (8), leaving the buffer size, loop bounds and escape-sequence parsing identical, and adds -Werror to the linenoise Makefile. Compiled output and runtime behavior are unchanged; the touched code is valkey-cli's interactive terminal line editing, not server behavior, so no scenario can or should test it.
